scenarios.name: log_replays
scenarios.note: A log of three events is replayed whole, from its second first-seen event, and from an anchor one of its events holds; its key state and mailbox are answered too.

scenarios.name: queries_wait_for_the_log
scenarios.note: Queries for an identifier not seen yet, and for a sequence number its log has not reached, wait, and are answered once the events arrive.

scenarios.name: recovered_log
scenarios.note: After a recovery rotation supersedes two interactions, the log replays every event in the order first seen, the superseded ones included.

scenarios.name: delegated_log
scenarios.note: A delegated identifier's log is replayed followed by its delegator's whole log.

scenarios.name: non_transferable_requester
scenarios.note: A query signed by a non-transferable key is answered when the log holds what it asks for; when it does not, keripy cannot escrow it without a transferable requester and refuses it.
